mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent exact coefficient routes, quartic packet reconstruction, residual squaring, Euler polynomial identities, finite-difference kernels and prime residual controls agree in the enumerated finite ranges. The expanded checks include reverse quartic transfer, composition enumeration, alternating-power telescoping, odd and dyadic local Euler reconstruction and their stated finite precision bounds. Exact finite blocks of the infinite coefficient, inverse, Toeplitz-normalized, packet and Pascal-conjugated sampling operators agree in the specified dimensions. Euler-to-Fibonacci polynomial connection, companion defect coordinates, variation of constants, moving states, and a reversible ordinary Toeplitz sequence transfer agree with their complementary exact constructions. Source-checked Paper IX packet recurrences, integral matrix refinement and simultaneous-prime ladders, and a typed Euler/Fibonacci calculus round trip agree with independent scalar and polynomial constructions. Four quartic-address rational and modular recurrences agree; displacement valuations, finite periods and residue isometries match the source laws in declared ranges. Finite Hurwitz mode inversion, signed Stirling/logarithmic coordinates and the transported derivative agree with independent coefficient routes.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z and Q, exact Python integers and fractions; polynomial and truncated formal-series coefficient arrays
mathematics.conventions: s_n is the positive coefficient of t^(2n)/(2n)! in sec(t); a_n=(-1)^n*s_n is the signed Euler number E_(2n). P_N,n(r) uses t^(N*n)/(N*n)!, not t^n/n!. All coefficient arrays are in ascending ordinary power order.
